required_capabilities.detail: Typed frontend output is available for runtime packaging.

axioms.name: kaintana_desktop_axiom
guarantees: kaintana desktop bridge uses native GDI/GDI+ rendering with window pump

axioms.name: kaintana_render_axiom
guarantees: kaintana render commands use retained and immediate UI lanes

axioms.name: kaintana_ui_truth
guarantees: kaintana desktop ui framework is supported

axioms.name: kaintana_vulkan_axiom
guarantees: kaintana vulkan adapter uses graphics_session for SPIR-V staging and probe

axioms.name: kaintana_widget_events_axiom
guarantees: kaintana widget event handlers use defer for automatic capture and state cleanup

axioms.name: kaintana_winit_axiom
guarantees: kaintana winit adapter manages session lifecycle with pump and present

notes: Full reflection payload emitted from kain-core.
Includes type schemas, item metadata, actors, components, and messages.
Bundle sidecars are emitted with the runtime contract.
Install can proceed once version and compatibility metadata are present.
Update is expected to replace a bundle only after compatibility validation passes.
Migration data is still optional at the compiler layer.
Uninstall removes emitted bundle artifacts together with compatibility metadata.

migration_hints: Preserve the runtime contract and reflection payload together when updating.
Validate bundle and runtime version records before activating a replacement.
